one_line: One personal memory line, 'I grew up on this, now my daughter will', carries a whole collection.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a closed yellow honey-pot gift box, top half of the frame, black below. 0:01 split view: the opened box above, a flat lay below. Voiceover (transcript): a new Pooh collection. Text 'פו הדב חוגג 100 שנה!' (0:01).
q1_hook.why: A famous character, a milestone and a gift box give a clear reason to stay (H1, H2, H5), and the headline is up by 0:01 (T3). But the first 0.6 s is a half-black frame (H7), and no person is on screen until 0:06, so the voice is a brand voice (H4).

beats.what: Closed gift box, then a split screen: opened box above, flat lay below; 'פו הדב חוגג 100 שנה!'
beats.why: A milestone and a box to open.

beats.what: A quilt, crib bedding, then a woman lifts the lid of a big box; 'ועוד מלא דברים מעלפים'
beats.why: Quick overview of what is inside.

beats.what: Top-down flat lay: plush, rattle, towel, socks; 'זה שאני גדלתי על פו הדב'; a baby plays
beats.why: The personal memory gives the reason to care.

beats.what: Talking head over the open box, she holds a picnic blanket that becomes a tote; 'שבעצם הופכת לתיק'
beats.why: A first benefit, shown in her hands.

beats.what: A baby plays on the quilt; 'ממש קל לקחת את זה איתכם'
Pan over the crib bumper and bedding; 'הפרינט הכי חמוד שקיים', 'שמתאים גם לבנים וגם לבנות'
beats.why: The prints are the selling point.

beats.what: Hands spread muslin blankets with Pooh, Tigger and Eeyore; 'בלי הטטרות של שילב'
beats.why: A third item, shown up close.

beats.what: Flat lay of the collection; 'פשוט קנו אותי.'

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption is two short lines and asks nothing.
q2_flow.why: A fast overview in the first 8 s, a personal memory at 0:08, then one item every 3 to 8 s, each with one reason (R3, K2). The baby shots at 0:14 and 0:22 add warmth between product shots (K8). It is a list of items with no count or build-up, and 39 s is long for it (R2, R1).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. The last subtitle 'פשוט קנו אותי.' refers to the prints, not an ask. Caption: 'קולקציית פו הדוב החדשה מחכה לכם בשילב!'. No link, code, price or comment word.
q3_cta.why: The caption line is a soft invitation, with no link, price or place to buy (C6, C3). The video ends on a pun, not a step. A single on-screen line saying where to find it would close the loop (C1).

q4_shown.what: The closed box 0:00; an opened box and a flat lay 0:01; the plush held 0:03; a woman opening a big box 0:06; a flat lay 0:08; a baby with the plush 0:14, 0:22; a picnic blanket as a tote 0:19; bedding 0:25; muslins 0:33.
q4_shown.why: The product is on screen at 0:00 and handled by 0:03 (S1). The licensed character on every item makes the range recognisable at a glance (K5). Her childhood story is first-hand (S6). The baby using the plush and quilt is the best proof, about 5 s in all (K8). The baby's face shows (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 17 shots in 39 s (2.3 s each): fast cuts and a split screen in the first 8 s, then 3 to 9 s holds on each product; one pan over the crib. Subtitles in short chunks. Ends on a flat lay.
q5_edit.why: A fast opening then a steady hold per item suits fabric and prints (E2, R3). The half-black first frame and split screen are not a full-bleed vertical start (H7, F1). Subtitles carry every sentence (T2). It ends on the verdict line, no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A 100-year Winnie the Pooh baby collection, introduced through a mother's childhood memory: blankets, bedding, plush. Serves parents of babies who like character items.
q6_topic.why: Nostalgia, 'I grew up on Pooh, now my daughter will', is a warm parent feeling (K1, K6), and the 100-year milestone gives a reason now, a gift moment (K7). The item claims, easy to carry and soft prints, are modest (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Phone: a fixed medium shot of a woman at a table in a bright room with a big yellow box; handheld top-down flat lays on a quilt; close-ups of fabric; a pan over a crib; a baby on a quilt from above. Daylight.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down flat lays put the viewer over the products (F5), and close-ups fill the frame so prints read (F4). She speaks to the lens at eye level (F6). The tidy room and gift box read as a brand unboxing (H8). The first frame is half black (F1).

q8_text.on_screen: Small white sans-serif subtitles, 1 to 2 lines, at about 75 to 80% of the frame height, following the voiceover: 'עם שמיכות' (0:04), 'זה שאני גדלתי על פו הדב' (0:09), 'ועכשיו גם הבת שלי תגדל על זה' (0:14), 'שבעצם הופכת לתיק' (0:19), 'שמתאים גם לבנים וגם לבנות' (0:31), 'פשוט קנו אותי.' (0:38). Headlines mid-frame at 0:01 and 0:03. No CTA.
q8_text.caption: 'קצת נוסטלגיה, הרבה מתיקות 🐻🍯' then 'קולקציית פו הדוב החדשה מחכה לכם בשילב!'. Two short lines, about 12 words. No hashtags, question or disclosure word.
q8_text.why: A headline in the first second states the topic (T3), and subtitles let a muted viewer follow (T1), but they are small and in the bottom 35% (T4, F2, T5). The caption is a pun and a promise with the brand name, no hashtags (T7), and no partnership word beside a listed co-author (T8, S7).

weak_points: A half-black first frame and a split screen; small subtitles in the bottom band; no price, store or link; no partnership word beside a listed co-author; a long list of items with no count.
lumebook_takeaway: A closed box at second 0, a milestone headline, then one personal-memory sentence over the product. The book arriving and being opened, hands only.
not_verified: Who the woman is (the listed co-author is not confirmed to be her); whether it is paid; music (none evident); the exact opening layout at 0.6 to 2.9 s (it looks like a split screen of two clips). Correction: the first frame is half black and the first text appears at about 1 s.
